Container.Paragraph: Write a foundation token in braces. The compiler binds it, so the same XML follows the light and dark theme. A bare number or hex color is a custom value and the compiler warns.
{space.4} is padding, gap, and control size. Steps run from space.1 through space.10.
{radius.md} is a corner. Aliases: radius.control, radius.card, radius.panel.
{type.body.size} and {type.body.weight} are the type role. Roles: display, h1, h2, h3, subhead, body, bodyLg, caption, button.
{layout.width.docs} is a layout length. Also breakpoints, page padding, columns, gutters, and the copy, wide, marketing, and section widths.

Container.Text: This panel uses color.bg.secondary, radius.lg, and space.4.

Container.Paragraph: Not built yet. A Code block will show this XML with highlighting. The markup above is the documentation until then.
Every color token has a light value and a dark value. Use it as background, color, or borderColor. The swatch is a Container because a color chip component is not a separate control.
Heading and Paragraph carry the semantic sizes. A Text node can also take a type token directly. Desktop size is first, then the mobile size.
Body copy uses the paragraph default. It stays 17px on mobile and desktop, with a 1.47 line height.
Not built yet. A Table will list role, size, mobile size, weight, tracking, and leading in columns. The samples above are the documentation until then.
Space is a 4px scale. Use it for padding, gap, and fixed control size. The gap between the two marks is the token.
Corners use a named radius. radius.control is md, radius.card is lg, and radius.panel is 2xl.
Layout tokens are the page grid. Breakpoints pick the padding, column count, and gutter. Width tokens cap a column.
Not built yet. A Screen will switch this page at the tablet and desktop breakpoints.
Not built yet. A Board is the blank canvas a Screen displays.
An icon is the tag of its name in RoboIcons.pack. Set width, height, and color with tokens. An IconButton uses the same name in its icon attribute.
Flags live in RoboCountry.pack and use the same tag as icons. These three are in the pack today.
Text is the typography primitive. Set its size, weight, and color with foundation tokens. Each Text node is one style.
<Text fontSize="{type.body.size}" fontWeight="{type.body.weight}" color="{color.text.primary}">Body copy stays at 17.</Text>
Heading is Text with a semantic size and weight. Levels run from 1 to 6. H1 through H6 are the same component.
Paragraph is body copy. It uses the body type role: 17px, regular weight, and a 1.47 line height.
A second paragraph stacks under the first with the page gap. Use it for explanation, and use Heading when the line is a title.
A second paragraph stacks under the first.
